minimum_requirements.cpu: x86_64 capable of running WSL2/Linux or native Linux
minimum_requirements.ram: Not yet published as a hard minimum; practical headroom recommended for Ollama
minimum_requirements.gpu: Optional for Lite; improves model tier
minimum_requirements.storage: Several GB free for WSL/images/models (exact minimum Not yet published)
minimum_requirements.docker: Optional, required for managed Expansion Video Studio sidecar path
minimum_requirements.network: Local loopback for Ollama; outbound optional for downloads/providers

capability_tiers.name: Core / basic

capability_tiers.capability: Lite operable with smaller Default Model (qwen2.5:1.5b path)

capability_tiers.name: Expanded local inference

capability_tiers.name: Heavier AI / creative
capability_tiers.capability: qwen2.5:14b Default Model tier; heavier creative needs separate GPU pipelines

capability_tiers.name: Advanced local workloads
